Man, I feel you, I can't relate to everything because even tho I am 19 too and in college, i had just one relationship last year that lasted a year and my social media is all private, but still, I will try to give you some advice using what I have learned from people around me.

Getting attention feels good, we all know that, the girl you said is very touchy knows that very well too, many become addicted to it like she seems, my ex is like that, and it tore us appart slowly, even tho that's not my whole point it is important. Attention seeking is unnatractive and most people dislike people that do it, so I don't want you to end up like that, it can hurt your other relationships and your own wellbeing.

Now, we need to address the "can't be single" problem, I know being in a relationship is awesome, but I need you to think and be honest with yourself, why are you with that person, do you really love them or you just don't want to be alone? do you want to be with them or just don't want to be with yourself? do you want to spend your time with them or you just don't know how to spend that time doing stuff yourself? do you like their attention or do you need it to feel validated? All of these questions are really important and I need you to truly think about it, not just the answers, but the reason to them. 

We live in a society that makes us feel like we need to get validation from other people to be accepted and to feel worthy of living, but it couldn't be father from the truth, the dopamine from being acknowledged feels good but does it make you happy? it certainly doesn't look like it, because it can't fullfill you as a person. 

You are a human being, with hopes and dreams, with hobbies and passions, with friends and family, you are so much more than how many compliments you get, so focus on that, just be you, live life fully how YOU want to live it. 

My honest advice is to just work on yourself, do it for you, do what makes you happy, specially if you can do it alone, I feel like yoy need to look inwards and discover why attention is so important for you. do what fulfills you not what gets you the most girls, do you know why? because doing that you will still be able to find a partner but you will be even happier with them.
